svg.title: Downloads
svg.desc: GitHub release downloads per day of jdx's tools, averaged over the 7 days to Oct 10, CI included: hk 100,887 (16% week over week), fnox 39,276 (7% week over week), usage 32,178 (3% week over week), aube 29,224 (66% week over week), mr boxington 23,967 (new), pitchfork 15,174 (27% week over week). jdx tools combined 18% week over week, all of mise 32%.

g.text: downloads · 7-day avg to Oct 10 · CI included
jdx tools +18% · all of mise +32% WoW
GitHub release downloads from mise-analytics, CI included.
Every asset counts, so one install can be several
downloads and these are not unique users. Installs through
npm and Homebrew aren't counted here.
